title: Pilot log-schema v2 acceptance test (§10)
author: 0B
method: 0C's identical pathological day, written through the REAL logger and measured by the REAL gate script (not a reimplementation)

M1_effective_cost_bps.detail: unique: benchmarked against mid_at_anchor (pinned); no alternative reading admissible because arrival mid is no longer the only available baseline

M2_markout_bps.detail: unique: maker-only, per CHILD fill (247 fills), notional-weighted

M3_fill_rate.detail: unique: denominator pinned to attempt_idx==1 intended, so re-posting can never double-count

M4_turnover.detail: unique: gate uses TARGET-weight turnover; realized reported alongside (2734.3)

M5_weight_fidelity.detail: reconciled against venue position_readback; shortfall split by terminal_reason so 'did not fill' and 'abandoned under F16' are distinguishable

M6_funding.detail: computable from the funding ledger (60 settlements) — was IMPOSSIBLE under v1 because funding does not flow through orders

STOPLOSS_inputs.detail: daily NAV series persisted -> single-day loss and cumulative drawdown are computable AND auditable after the fact

M2_markout.sign_convention: positive = adverse (mid moved against us 60s after the fill)

M3_fill_rate.definition: denominator = intended_notional of attempt_idx==1 only (never summed across attempts; attempt 2's intended is a residual)

M4_turnover.gate_uses: target_weight (validates the signal pipeline); realized reported alongside

M6_sign_consistency.note: bug detector, not an alpha test — a wiring error is a large deterministic effect, so no statistical test is appropriate; active from day 1
